Order 
This first application under Section 438 of Cr.P.C./482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail.
2. Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.216/2024 of Police Station -Omti Jabalpur, (MP) for commission of the offence punishable under Sections 406 & 420 of the IPC.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that an amount of Rs.10,00,000/- was deposited by the complainant in the Bank account of the accused - Birendra Paswan in the year 2020 towards supply of some machinery, but no machinery was supplied and for the purpose of settlement of account, an amount of Rs.3,00,000/- was paid by the accused to the complainant by way of cheque, which has already been encashed by the complainant.

Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that the applicant is ready and willing to pay remaining amount of Rs.7,00,000/- on or before 24.01.2026 in the bank account of the complainant - Brajesh Kumar Babele.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the complainant submits that, if an amount of Rs.7,00,000/- is deposited by the accused - Birendra Paswan in the Bank account of the complainant - Brajesh Kumar Babele, then he has no objection in granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.

5. In view of above, upon depositing Rs.7,00,000/- by the accused- Birendra Paswan in the Bank account of the complainant - Brajesh Kumar Babele, on or before 24.01.2026, this Court deems it proper to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.
It is also hereby directed that the applicant shall also file an affidavit in the present case indicating that he would pay an amount of Rs.7,00,000/- to the complainant- Brajesh Kumar Babele.
6. Consequently, anticipatory bail application filed on behalf of applicant stands allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant in the event of his arrest, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer.
It is also directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions as enumerated under Section 438(2) of Cr.P.C.

It is made clear that applicant shall appear before the Investigating Officer as & when he is so directed and cooperate with the investigation and he shall also appear before the Trial Court failing which his bail shall automatically stand cancelled without further reference to the Court.
